why: formal-fixer was required because the validated failures affect TapTap launch/runtime rendering on two Android device branches and the release package. RED reproduced four missing contracts. The narrow repair removes the vivo-crashing runtime MeshRenderer/new Material/primitive activation chain and draws the unchanged touch journey through Cocos UI Graphics, adds a 390x844 fixed-width runtime/safe-area contract, and records that InstantGameActivity is owned by the TapTap Android container while the package owns only its root entrypoints. Tests, lint and typecheck are GREEN, and the one allowed Cocos 3.8.8 build produced a structurally valid official-plugin ZIP. However, post-build inspection found that ZIP src/settings.json still contains the pre-repair 1280x720 exactFitScreen=true startup settings. cocos-build-config.json was then synchronized to 390x844 fixed-width, but the build cap prevents rebuilding this attempt, so this ZIP is stale relative to the final configuration and cannot be sent to independent QA as fixed. Context intentionally omitted: other runs, web-lite, WeChat/Douyin implementations, unrelated prior-cycle details, advertising, IAP, cloud save, rankings, and third-party game expression/assets/tuning.
